MainWindow.Status.ReadOnly: Read-only. You can't save these settings.
MainWindow.Status.SavingApplies: Saving applies the changes to the running Snapwell.
MainWindow.Close.Title: Save changes?
MainWindow.Close.Message: You have unsaved changes. Saving applies them to the running Snapwell.
General_EnabledDescription.Text: Turning this off restores Windows Snap. You can also use the tray menu. Changes apply immediately.
General_AdminStartDescription.Text: Also move windows of apps running as administrator. Uses Task Scheduler and shows a Windows confirmation. Takes effect at your next sign-in.
General_MovePopupDescription.Text: Move small windows, such as those opened from the taskbar, with hotkeys or dragging without taking focus. They aren't included in arrangement, and some can't be dragged.
General.Startup.MissingExecutable: Can't set up auto-start because Snapwell.exe isn't in the same folder.
General.Device.FutureEnabled: Can't turn Snapwell on or off because the device state is from a newer version. Update Snapwell.
General.Device.Unreadable: Can't read the device state. Check the file location and permissions, then reopen settings.
General.Device.SaveEnabledFailed: Couldn't save the on/off state. Check the file location and permissions.
General.Startup.Elsewhere: Snapwell from another location is registered. Turn this off and on to use the copy in this folder.
General.Startup.ExpandablePath: Can't register administrator startup from a path containing %.
General.Startup.ProtectedLocation: Place Snapwell in a protected location on a local fixed drive, such as Program Files. Links aren't supported.
General.Startup.PendingRestore: The previous auto-start settings haven't been restored. Turn administrator startup on and off to retry.
General.Startup.Cancelled: No changes were made because administrator access wasn't granted.
General.Startup.ExpandablePathError: Can't register administrator startup from a path containing %.
General.Startup.UnprotectedLocation: Use a location that only administrators can write to.
General.Startup.AdminNextSignIn: Snapwell will start as administrator at your next sign-in.
General.Startup.Failed: Couldn't read or write auto-start registration. Check permissions.
General.Language.Future: Can't change the language because the device state is from a newer version. Update Snapwell.
General.Language.SaveFailed: Couldn't save the language. Check the file location and permissions.
Language.ChangedNotice: Reopen settings to change this screen's language. The tray menu changes the next time you open it.
